title: Mold Remediation Customer Payments, Card Surcharge and Refunds
content:
The job must not be closed when a customer payment is posted. Customer payments on a Mold Remediation job are accepted by credit card, debit card, ACH or check and are posted in full to the one job they name; a credit card payment carries a surcharge of the credit card surcharge percentage of the payment amount, booked as its own line and rounded to the cent, half up, and no other tender is surcharged.

A refund is issued only while the job's balance due is negative, for the credit balance but never more than the customer payment it is returned from, to that payment's original tender, within the refund processing business days; a credit balance created by insurance proceeds is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.

## Payments

| Tender | Surcharge line |
|---|---|
| Credit card | Yes, the surcharge percentage of the payment amount, rounded to the cent, half up |
| Debit card | No |
| ACH | No |
| Check | No |

- The job's status on the company's records decides whether a payment may post: every status except closed admits it.
- A payment names one job and is posted to that job in full; it is not split across jobs.

## Refunds

- Condition: the job's balance due is below zero.
- Amount: the credit balance, but never more than the customer payment the refund is returned from.
- Destination: that payment's original tender.
- Timing: within the refund processing business days, Monday to Friday excluding company holidays.
- A credit balance created by insurance proceeds is not refunded under this rule; it is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- A credit card payment of 1180.00 carries a surcharge line of 2.95 percent of 1180.00, which is 34.81; the same payment by ACH carries none.
- A job shows a balance due of minus 260.00 after a customer check of 200.00 and an earlier customer card payment of 500.00. A refund returned from the check is capped at 200.00; a refund returned from the card payment may cover the whole 260.00.
